name: env
title: Population, night-time lights, electricity-based GDP, NPP and PM2.5
description: An annual panel for Cambodia's 25 provinces that aggregates five global gridded remote-sensing products to the province level: population, VIIRS-like night-time lights, electricity-based GDP, net primary productivity and PM2.5 concentration. Each `total_*` variable is the zonal sum of the grid values inside a province's boundary. Rows run from 1990 to 2023; each variable has its own coverage.

sources.title: Liu, L., Cao, X., Li, S., & Jie, N. (2024). A 31-year (1990–2020) global gridded population dataset generated by cluster analysis and statistical learning. Scientific Data, 11, 124.

Chen, Z., Yu, B., Yang, C., Zhou, Y., Yao, S., Qian, X., Wang, C., Wu, B., & Wu, J. (2021). An extended time series (2000–2018) of global NPP-VIIRS-like nighttime light data from a cross-sensor calibration. Earth System Science Data, 13, 889–906.

Chen, J., Gao, M., Cheng, S., Hou, W., Song, M., Liu, X., & Liu, Y. (2022). Global 1 km × 1 km gridded revised real gross domestic product and electricity consumption during 1992–2019 based on calibrated nighttime light data. Scientific Data, 9, 202.

Robinson, N. P., Allred, B. W., Smith, W. K., Jones, M. O., Moreno, A., Erickson, T. A., Naugle, D. E., & Running, S. W. (2018). Terrestrial primary production for the conterminous United States derived from Landsat 30 m and MODIS 250 m. Remote Sensing in Ecology and Conservation, 4(3), 264–280.

Wei, J., Li, Z., Lyapustin, A., Wang, J., Dubovik, O., Schwartz, J., Sun, L., Li, C., Liu, S., & Zhu, T. (2023). First close insight into global daily gapless 1 km PM2.5 pollution, variability, and health impact. Nature Communications, 14, 8349.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Cambodia (2025). Population, (VIIRS-like) lights, electricity-based GDP, net primary productivity, and PM2.5 (25 provinces, 1990–2023). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4cambodia/blob/main/docs/datasets/env.md
geo:notes: Known issue: in the source release `total_NPP` is 0 for every province and year. It is published as missing until the dataset is regenerated.
The zonal sums were computed on geoBoundaries ADM1 polygons, which differ slightly from the GADM provinces used for geo IDs. `shapeISO` keeps the original geoBoundaries code.
GDO province numbers follow GADM order and differ from the ISO 3166-2 numbers in `shapeISO` (e.g. Phnom Penh is KH-16 in GDO and KH-12 in ISO).
